rules.subject: prior-source-access
rules.statement: Do not read, mount, clone, search, quote, paraphrase, or reconstruct prior implementation source.

rules.subject: permitted-input-provenance
rules.statement: Cite a permitted specification, public standard, structural reference, or provenance-bound black-box fixture for every behavior claim.

rules.subject: structural-reference-boundary
rules.statement: Use structural references only to locate ownership and migration destinations, never to infer the implementation behind them.

rules.subject: typed-transitions
rules.statement: Represent lifecycle changes as named typed transitions with invalid-state rejection.

rules.subject: durable-fencing
rules.statement: Bind ownership-changing transitions to durable identities or epochs and prove at most one active owner.

rules.subject: restart-evidence
rules.statement: Test the failure and restart boundaries named by the work contract, including cleanup and replay outcomes.

rules.subject: least-authority
rules.statement: Grant only the paths, commands, network, credentials, resources, and external effects declared by the work unit.

rules.subject: credential-output
rules.statement: Do not place credential values in argv, logs, manifests, evidence, fixtures, or committed files.

rules.subject: typed-command-boundary
rules.statement: Execute approved argument vectors or typed APIs; never construct a shell command from model output.

rules.subject: canonical-owner
rules.statement: Resolve canonical and compatibility names to one runtime owner and one durable identity.

rules.subject: compatibility-behavior
rules.statement: Keep compatibility entry points as forwarding or codec boundaries without duplicate domain behavior.

rules.subject: unapproved-rename
rules.statement: Do not rename durable identifiers or compatibility surfaces without an explicit migration contract.

rules.subject: test-silencing
rules.statement: Do not delete, skip, ignore, weaken, stub, bulk-refresh, or broadly suppress a test to make a gate pass.

rules.subject: failure-paths
rules.statement: Exercise the contract's negative, restart, cleanup, compatibility, and fault paths rather than compilation alone.

rules.subject: truthful-review
rules.statement: Record the actual reviewer count and never claim independence for the implementing context.

rules.subject: missing-metric
rules.statement: Represent unavailable or incomparable measurements as null with a reason, never as zero or pass.

rules.subject: judging-contract
rules.statement: Do not change the metric, baseline, test, policy, licence, or budget used to judge the same work unit.

rules.subject: descriptive-volume
rules.statement: Treat lines, commits, tokens, cost, calls, and agent count as descriptive rather than correctness rewards.
